g.text: Corrected v10 · four fixed observations · eight independent populations per arm
A–B: maxima over both score components; B also spans all three arm pairs. Region and normalizer gates also pass.
D: both numerical measures, raw + controlled scores, on represented states only. No global shear-bias or missing-mode bound.
